request.prompt_head:
The person asks:
Until when can I cancel my electricity contract because of the price increase?

response.text:
Ordnung doesn't have a separately computed cancellation deadline for the special right triggered by this price increase — no such deadline item was created from that letter.

What I can tell you from the records:

- The price‑increase letter from Stadtwerke Musterstadt names an effective date for the new prices, but that date is only in the letter text itself, so I can't confirm it here — please check it on the letter (doc_asph8a6ddy4e) [doc:doc_asph8a6ddy4e].
- Under the contract's normal notice rule (not the price-increase special right), the earliest your electricity contract could end is Mon 2 Nov 2026, if your cancellation arrives by Fri 2 Oct 2026 [contract:ctr_bbzemyapzvm5].
- Separately, the letter also raises your monthly advance payment; that increased amount is due starting Sun 15 Nov 2026 [item:itm_v3m35j0h5pwv].

Since German energy law gives a special right to cancel without notice when the price change takes effect (§ 41 Abs. 5 EnWG, per that letter), and the exact effective date isn't confirmed in Ordnung's record, I'd recommend checking the effective date printed on the letter itself and, if in doubt, cancelling promptly via "Draft letter" or the provider's portal rather than relying on the normal one-month notice date above.
